## DO NOT EDIT

- [src/main.ts]
- [src/shared.ts]
- [package.json]
  - These are essential for the entire application and will likely break the entire bot.
  - Seek permission from the author to add a new package.
- Features not authored by the user.
  - Features are intended to be standalone, so try to avoid editing features irrelevant to the current prompt.

## Features Format

Refer to [src/features/example/] for an example on how to make a new feature.
